figures.caption_zh: 四种材料表示在共同 16/32/64 个实参数预算下的 achieved offline 材料误差。先平均每个 parent 的 weak/ring 两背景，再等权平均 parent；区间为 2000 次探索性 parent bootstrap。存在缺失或 invalid parent 的组不绘制完整统计点，原表保留所有失败行。非凸拟合的 achieved error 不是全局容量下界，曲线不提供测量可部署性证明。
figures.caption_en: Achieved offline material-fit error for four representations at matched real parameter budgets. Conditions are averaged inside each parent before equal-parent aggregation. Missing or invalid parent pairs suppress the corresponding aggregate point. Achieved nonconvex fits are not global capacity certificates or deployable recovery results.

figures.caption_zh: 每个 family 预先固定的第一个 weak 条件：250065/250069/250073/250077。图中为实际 |χ−χ_b|，所有列共用 0–1.2 色标且不逐图归一化；原表保留实部、虚部、模与超色标标志。best-64 为这些固定 case 上四种合法表示的 offline 误差最小者，明确为 ORACLE；invalid/NaN 不作有效图像。观察图像不替代复杂 parent 总体统计或 topology 证书。
figures.caption_en: The first weak-background case of each family is fixed before inspecting error. Images show actual |chi minus background| on one shared 0–1.2 scale; exported pixels retain real/imaginary components and clipping flags. Best-64 is an explicitly offline per-case oracle among valid saved representations. NaN/invalid fits are not rendered as valid materials.
notes: Pixel row/column coordinates; no physical coordinate or unit is invented.
Values above 1.2 saturate visually and remain unchanged in the raw table.

figures.caption_zh: 全部 16 个 exposed parent 的材料相对改善，按 family 原顺序列出。每个单元先平均 weak/ring 误差，再计算 (N3−candidate)/N3。左侧引用保存 hull 汇总；右侧为 budget64 表示的实际保存结果。缺失标 NR、invalid 标 INV，均不替换为零。smooth 单列保留，不进入 12 complex parents 的主统计。
figures.caption_en: All 16 exposed parents, with both backgrounds averaged before relative gain is calculated. Hull cells are copied from saved summaries; representation cells use saved budget-64 fits. NR and INV denote missing and invalid evidence, not zero gain. Smooth parents remain distinct from the complex primary group.
